Get the PK parameters requested in a PKNCA interval specification

get_pk_parameters_from_pknca_options.Rd

The PKNCA option single.dose.aucs (see PKNCA::PKNCA.options()) is a data.frame with one row per NCA interval (start, end) and one logical column per PK parameter. Wherever a parameter is set to TRUE, PKNCA will compute it for that interval. This function returns the names of all parameters requested for at least one interval, so that they can be made available in the output from run_nca().

Usage

get_pk_parameters_from_pknca_options(options = NULL, no_dots = FALSE)

Arguments

options

data.frame with interval specification for NCA, in the format of PKNCA::PKNCA.options()$single.dose.aucs. If NULL (default), the currently active PKNCA option single.dose.aucs is used.

no_dots

if TRUE, will replace any dots in parameter names (e.g. aucinf.obs) with underscores (aucinf_obs). Default is FALSE, i.e. PKNCA parameter names are returned unchanged.

Value

character vector of PK parameter names (possibly of length 0).

Details

Only logical columns are considered parameter columns. Other columns (e.g. start, end, impute) are ignored, regardless of their values. NA values are treated as not requested.

Parameters are returned in order of first appearance, scanning intervals (rows) in order and, within each interval, parameter columns from left to right. Each parameter is returned only once.

The result depends only on options. When options is NULL, the currently active PKNCA options are used, i.e. PKNCA::PKNCA.options()$single.dose.aucs, so calling the function with NULL or with that value explicitly gives identical results. Note that run_nca() restores the PKNCA options on exit, so calling run_nca() does not change the result of a later call with options = NULL.
